fullDescription.text: Weak or missing authentication on routes managed by API Gateway APIGateway, allowing unauthorized access to backend services.
Data corruption or tampering in AppDatabase via unauthorized write access
Unauthorized privilege escalation on UserService due to misconfiguration or vulnerability
Unauthorized access to sensitive data stored in AppDatabase leading to data breach
Unauthorized privilege escalation on ServiceDiscovery due to misconfiguration or vulnerability
Critical Elevation of Privilege: Unauthenticated data flow from UserService is allowed to interact with a critical database AppDatabase.
Improper rate limiting on API Gateway APIGateway, leading to Denial of Service.
Unpatched OS or software vulnerabilities on UserService leading to system compromise
Unauthorized privilege escalation on ProductService due to misconfiguration or vulnerability
Unpatched OS or software vulnerabilities on ServiceDiscovery leading to system compromise
Data interception on an unencrypted channel from APIGateway to UserService (Man-in-the-Middle attack)
Data interception on an unencrypted channel from UserService to MessageBroker (Man-in-the-Middle attack)
Data interception on an unencrypted channel from MessageBroker to ProductService (Man-in-the-Middle attack)
Data interception on an unencrypted channel from UserService to AppDatabase (Man-in-the-Middle attack)
Privilege abuse by actor End User to gain unauthorized access or perform unauthorized actions
Privilege abuse by actor Developer/Operator to gain unauthorized access or perform unauthorized actions
Potential for spoofing attacks on data crossing trust boundaries from APIGateway to UserService without proper authentication
Denial of Service against AppDatabase through resource-intensive queries or excessive connections
Message flood or oversized messages filling the queues of broker MessageBroker, stalling its consumers
Unpatched OS or software vulnerabilities on ProductService leading to system compromise
Insecure security configuration or hardening on UserService leading to information exposure
Weak SSL/TLS configuration or ciphers used by Load Balancer leading to information disclosure
Insecure security configuration or hardening on ServiceDiscovery leading to information exposure
Lack of monitoring or logging on UserService, preventing detection of malicious activities and enabling repudiation
Volumetric network flood saturating load balancer Load Balancer and every service behind it
No audit trail of data changes in AppDatabase, so modifications cannot be attributed to a user
Session hijacking or fixation attack against the Load Balancer leading to unauthorized access
Spoofing of data from End User to Load Balancer due to lack of authentication
Spoofing of data from Load Balancer to APIGateway due to lack of authentication
Spoofing of data from APIGateway to UserService due to lack of authentication
Spoofing of data from UserService to MessageBroker due to lack of authentication
Spoofing of data from MessageBroker to ProductService due to lack of authentication
Spoofing of data from UserService to AppDatabase due to lack of authentication
Identity spoofing of the actor End User via phishing or credential theft
Identity spoofing of the actor Developer/Operator via phishing or credential theft
Lack of monitoring or logging on ServiceDiscovery, preventing detection of malicious activities and enabling repudiation
Insecure security configuration or hardening on ProductService leading to information exposure
Repudiation of critical actions performed by End User due to insufficient logging or non-repudiation controls
Repudiation of critical actions performed by Developer/Operator due to insufficient logging or non-repudiation controls
Lack of monitoring or logging on ProductService, preventing detection of malicious activities and enabling repudiation
